question: What is the area of the segment formed by a chord in a circle of radius 8 cm, if the angle subtended at the center is 60°?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of segment = Area of sector − Area of triangle

Area = [(θ ÷ 360°) × πr²] − [(1 ÷ 2) × r² × sin(θ)]

Substitute r = 8 cm and θ = 60°:

Area = [(60 ÷ 360) × π × 8²] − [(1 ÷ 2) × 8² × sin(60°)]

Area = (64π ÷ 6) − (32 × √3 ÷ 2)

Area = 32π/3 − 16√3 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 32π/3 − 16√3 cm².**
